entries.name: Academic Advising (Advise USC)
entries.contactMethod: Advise USC at https://usc.edu/advise to reach your own advisor. the office of academic programs, which runs the advising page, is at (213) 740-9033 or academic.programs@usc.edu
entries.details: u find and connect with your own academic advisor on advise usc (https://usc.edu/advise). usc calls it the central place where students across the university connect with their advisors, and u log in with your usc account.

entries.name: Campus Support & Intervention (CSI)
entries.details: campus support and intervention helps students navigate complicated situations, points u to the right resources, handles student health leave of absence and can notify professors case by case. they're in tutor campus center suite 421 and answer emails within one business day. they are not an emergency resource and not 24/7, so for an emergency call dps at 213-740-4321. if ur worried about another trojan, the trojans care 4 trojans form is at https://campussupport.usc.edu/tc4t/

entries.name: DPS Lost & Found
entries.details: University Park Campus: 3667 McClintock Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90089. Students report a lost item by calling or emailing, and drop found items off at that address. Found items are kept for 90 days from the date DPS receives them.

entries.name: Facilities Management Services (FMS)
entries.contactMethod: Online service request, or the FMS Customer Resource Center at (213) 740-6833 for urgent problems on the University Park Campus
entries.details: Handles day-to-day operation, repair and maintenance of USC buildings, infrastructure and grounds. Non-urgent requests go through the online service request form linked from the FPM FAQ (https://fpm.usc.edu/faq/), which points to https://usc.assetworks.cloud/ready. Urgent facilities problems go to the Customer Resource Center by phone. Troy's link into this system is mocked for the demo.

entries.name: ITS Customer Support Center
entries.details: the its customer support center is usc's tech help desk. call 213-740-5555 any time (the page says 24 hours a day, 7 days a week) or open a ticket at https://itsusc.service-now.com/usc_its_support. some requests may need a government id to verify you.

entries.name: Office of Academic Records and Registrar
entries.contactMethod: Registration Services at (213) 740-8500, or Grades, Transcripts and Verifications at (213) 740-7445
entries.details: the registrar's office is in the john hubbard hall (jhh) lobby, 700 childs way, open 9am to 5pm monday to friday. u add and drop classes on web registration (https://webreg.usc.edu/Login), the current add/drop deadlines are posted on the registration calendar (https://arr.usc.edu/registration-calendar/), and transcripts are at https://arr.usc.edu/transcripts-services/.

entries.name: USC Counseling & Mental Health Services
entries.details: usc counseling and mental health is part of usc student health. call 213-740-9355, their crisis support page lists it as the 24/7 line. to book a let's talk session, a workshop, a therapy group or request a therapist appointment, use myshr at https://usc.edu/myshr

entries.name: USC Financial Aid Office
entries.contactMethod: (213) 740-4444, or the askUSC contact form at https://ask.usc.edu/s/emailus
entries.details: the financial aid office is in the john hubbard hall (jhh) lobby and answers phones 9am to 5pm pacific, monday to friday. current deadlines and cost of attendance are posted on financialaid.usc.edu, and the undergrad deadlines page is https://financialaid.usc.edu/undergraduate-financial-aid/admitted-and-continuing-students/dates-and-deadlines/.

entries.name: USC Housing maintenance
entries.contactMethod: Work Orders link on housing.usc.edu, or the USC Housing Services Office at (800) 872-4632 or housing@usc.edu
entries.details: Residents submit maintenance problems in USC Housing buildings through the Work Orders link on the USC Housing home page (https://hsmtma.usc.edu:444/home.html). Troy's link into this system is mocked for the demo.

entries.name: USC Lyft Rides Program
entries.details: the usc lyft rides program gives current students free shared lyft rides around upc from 7pm to 2am every night (hsc is 5pm to 2am mon to fri). in the lyft app, check that the usc lyft rides pass shows under payment, pick shared, no added stops, and start and end inside the usc zone. if u dont have the pass, the invite form is at https://transnet.usc.edu/index.php/lyft-invite/ and the boundary maps are on the program page. on home football game days it can start later.

entries.name: USC Office of International Services (OIS)
entries.contactMethod: askOIS contact form at https://ois.usc.edu/ask-ois/ (J-1 students: j1student@usc.edu)
entries.details: ois helps international students with visas, immigration requirements and travel. f-1 students can join zoom drop-in advising monday to friday 1 to 3pm (the room closes at 2:30, and it is off on university holidays) from the contact page, or send the askois form. if u are on an f-1 or j-1 u need ois approval before dropping below full time, so ask them before u drop a class.

entries.name: USC Student Basic Needs
entries.details: student basic needs runs the trojan food pantry, calfresh help, emergency meal swipes, tommy's table and tommy's closet. the pantry is in king hall (koh) suite 103, open tue, wed and thu 10am to 2pm in fall and spring from the first week of classes. u fill out the intake form once a semester and bring ur physical uscard and a reusable bag. the form and current hours are at https://studentbasicneeds.usc.edu/programs-and-services/food-support/trojan-food-pantry/

entries.name: USC Ticket Office
entries.details: the usc ticket office handles student athletics tickets. full-time students can buy one football season ticket, it's sent to your phone and you still need your uscard to get into the coliseum; ordering links are on https://ticketoffice.usc.edu/for-the-usc-community/usc-athletics-tickets-for-students/. for other sports your uscard is your ticket to regular-season home games, first come first served. phones are answered monday to friday 11am to 4pm august through may (11am to 3pm june and july), and they're not open for walk-ins on non-event days.

entries.name: USC Transportation
entries.contactMethod: 213-740-3575 (University Park Campus customer service) or online form at https://transnet.usc.edu/index.php/feedback/
entries.details: usc transportation handles parking permits and the free usc buses. permits are bought online at https://usc.aimsparking.com (student steps are linked from https://transnet.usc.edu/index.php/how-to-purchase-a-permit-2/), current permit prices are posted at https://transnet.usc.edu/index.php/parking-rates/, and bus maps and schedules are at https://transnet.usc.edu/index.php/bus-map-schedules/. the upc office is at 620 usc mccarthy way (mccarthy structure), open 8:30am to 3:00pm monday through friday.

entries.name: USCard Services
entries.details: uscard services handles student ids. if your uscard is lost or stolen, log in at https://mycard.usc.edu/login/ to freeze it, then request a replacement at https://mycard.usc.edu/replacement-id. the current replacement fee is posted on https://mycard.usc.edu/get-your-uscard/. the upc customer service center is in the mccarthy way parking structure, 620 mccarthy way, open monday to friday 9am to 5pm.

entries.name: USG Committee on Academic Affairs
entries.details: usg's academic affairs committee covers the academic experience and learning environment for undergrads.

entries.name: USG Committee on Accessibility Affairs
entries.details: usg's accessibility committee covers ada compliance at usc and the needs of students with disabilities.

entries.name: USG Committee on Affordability and Basic Needs
entries.details: usg's affordability and basic needs committee covers students' financial barriers on campus and access to basic needs.

entries.name: USG Committee on External Affairs
entries.details: usg's external affairs committee covers the neighborhood around usc and usc's relationship with la county and local government.

entries.name: USG Committee on Sustainability and Campus Infrastructure
entries.details: usg's sustainability and campus infrastructure committee covers infrastructure, safety, hospitality and sustainable operations on campus.

entries.name: USG Committee on Wellness Affairs
entries.details: usg's wellness affairs committee covers student well-being: mental, physical, sexual and spiritual health.

entries.name: USG Funding Department
entries.details: usg's funding department handles funding applications from student orgs and undergrads.

entries.name: USG general contact
entries.details: usg's general inbox. usg's site says the senate meets tuesdays at 7pm in tcc 450, and each meeting has an open forum where u can bring ideas or concerns.

entries.name: USG LAX shuttle
entries.details: usg runs a shuttle to lax around breaks. hit up usg for this year's dates and how to sign up.

entries.name: USG RSO funding
entries.details: recognized student orgs and usc undergrads can apply for usg funding on engagesc. apps are due wednesdays by 11:59pm, six academic weeks before the event (or nine before the first payment is due, whichever comes first), and an rso can get up to 4 events funded a semester as long as it stays under $8,000 from usg a year. the senate was looking at changing the deadline rules in oct 2026, so double check the page before u plan around them.

entries.name: USG farmers market
entries.details: the trojan farmers market is on mccarthy quad, put on by usc hospitality. the next ones are wed nov 18 and wed dec 2. usc's two listings disagree on the hours (one says 10am to 2pm, the other 11am to 3pm), so 11am to 2pm is the safe window. ebt works for produce, nuts, eggs and honey.

entries.name: USG thrift
entries.details: usg runs a thrift for students. ask usg where and when the next one is.
